automated_gate_policy.blocked_rule: Any required check with fail, skip, unsupported, timeout, or tool-error blocks the automated gate.
automated_gate_policy.not_evaluated_rule: No automated judgment is made when producer-package validation or ae-framework invocation cannot complete.
automated_gate_policy.satisfied_rule: All required checks have status pass; optional non-pass records remain visible.

limitations: ae-framework organizes supplied Evidence and is not an oracle of truth.
The output is neither a security proof nor certification.
Automated satisfaction is not human approval or publication approval.
Fixture producers are synthetic and do not establish Product correctness.
No live Product Evidence, private input, or public export is processed.

producer_status_mapping.rationale: Reviewed execution matched its expected contract.
producer_status_mapping.required_limitation: Pass is limited to the stated synthetic check and does not prove Product correctness.

producer_status_mapping.rationale: Reviewed execution completed with a failed assertion or mismatch.
producer_status_mapping.required_limitation: Failure remains visible and blocks a required gate.

producer_status_mapping.rationale: A reviewed condition intentionally prevented execution.
producer_status_mapping.required_limitation: Skipped work is not evidence of successful execution.

producer_status_mapping.rationale: The required capability or selected implementation is unavailable.
producer_status_mapping.required_limitation: Unsupported capability is not converted to pass.

producer_status_mapping.rationale: The reviewed deterministic execution bound was exceeded.
producer_status_mapping.required_limitation: Timeout is preserved and is not converted to fail.

producer_status_mapping.rationale: Producer, adapter, parser, or tool processing failed.
producer_status_mapping.required_limitation: Tool failure is preserved and is not converted to fail.
